name: Disorder of Neurotransmitter Metabolism and Transport

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Consensus Criteria for Neurotransmitter Metabolism Disorders

criteria.description: Detection of abnormal neurotransmitter metabolites in cerebrospinal fluid or plasma
Presence of neurological symptoms such as dystonia, hypotonia, or developmental delay
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes involved in neurotransmitter metabolism or transport
Improvement of symptoms following neurotransmitter precursor or cofactor therapy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of biochemical abnormalities plus clinical neurological signs and genetic confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis may be supported by therapeutic response and exclusion of other metabolic disorders

pathognomonic.notes: Symptoms worsen in the evening and improve after sleep

searchTerms: low muscle tone with delayed development

pathognomonic.notes: Involuntary upward deviation of the eyes

common.notes: Includes sweating abnormalities and temperature instability

laboratory: Abnormal cerebrospinal fluid neurotransmitter metabolite levels (e.g., decreased homovanillic acid, 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid)
Elevated plasma or urine neurotransmitter precursors or metabolites
Abnormal enzyme activity assays in fibroblasts or blood cells
imaging: Normal or nonspecific brain MRI findings
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes such as SLC6A3, TH, DDC, or GCH1
other: Positive response to neurotransmitter precursor supplementation (e.g., L-DOPA, 5-HTP)

redFlags: Early onset progressive dystonia with diurnal fluctuation
Failure to thrive with neurological regression
references: Wassenberg T, et al. Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of tetrahydrobiopterin deficiencies. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2010.
Pearl PL, et al. Disorders of neurotransmitter metabolism. Handb Clin Neurol. 2013.
Orphanet: Disorder of neurotransmitter metabolism and transport. ORPHA:79169.
